subject: Hosted API — pricing sanction for Springwell bulk commit
messages:
From: Jared Summers <jared.summers@springwell.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Large commit — pricing ask

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We ran internal numbers and Springwell is prepared to sign a 12‑month committed usage contract for Hosted API: estimated average 22M tokens / month (peak 40M) with predictable monthly invoices.

To make this work in our model we need a 35% unit price reduction off list hosted-token rates (we're also asking for a 45‑day payment term). Can Redwood do 35%? If not, what’s your best authorized concession and what approval level is required?

We need to close by May 24 to align with our quarterly budget. Happy to walk through numbers if helpful.

—Jared
Jared Summers
Head of Integrations, Springwell Health
jared.summers@springwell.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Summers <jared.summers@springwell.com>
Cc: Springwell Procurement <procurement@springwell.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Large commit — pricing ask

Jared —

Appreciate the fast follow. I attached an updated Mutual Action Plan and a pricing sketch that reflects a few concession scenarios (high, mid, low). High level:
- List token rate: $0.0007 per token
- 35% off list = $0.000455 per token
- At 22M tokens/mo this is ~ $9.98k/mo (committed) but peak months push cost higher

We can consider a blended committed rate + overage structure to control risk. I’ll need internal sanction for anything >20% off list. Putting together the cost model now and will escalate.

Attached: Springwell_MA_plan_v3.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Next steps: I’ll run numbers with finance and request an exception approval. Can you confirm the preferred invoicing cadence and whether 45‑day terms are dealbreaker?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-17T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pricing sanction for Springwell (deal >20% discount)

Folks —

Summary: Springwell (large payer in behavioral health) wants a 12‑month committed Hosted API contract, ~22M tokens/mo average, asking for 35% off list and 45‑day payment terms. They need to close by 5/24.

Why this matters:
- Strategic account with strong references in payer integrations (upside for redwood adoption in healthcare space)
- Expected committed ARR (first year): ~ $120k gross at list; with 35% concession ARR drops to ~ $78k — still meaningful retention and optical for enterprise momentum

Risk & mitigation:
- Margin hit on token economics if we give 35% across the board. Proposal uses committed baseline + tiered overage to protect unit economics.
- Tech risk: peak months (40M) may need burst capacity — recommend include Dedicated burst clause or rate increase above 30M tokens/mo.

Ask (clear):
- Authorization to offer up to 35% off list hosted token price (final proposed blended rate $0.00046/token) conditioned on: 1) 12‑month minimum commit, 2) tiered overage, 3) 30‑day payment on Redwood standard, OR if 45‑day required then include 2% revenue reserve / fee.
- If you prefer, authorize a capped concession of 30% without further exec escalation.

Quick economics snapshot (high level):
- List price monthly: ~$15.4k (at list $0.0007/token)
- 35% concession monthly: ~$10k (impact ~$5.4k/mo)
- One‑time enablement credits: we propose $10k professional services (negotiable) rather than additional discounting

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MAP) — pricing scenarios tab highlighted. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/in/contacts/12345 (Deal: DEAL-20270517-SPRINGWELL)

Timing: need decision by EOD 5/19 to maintain our forward with legal and get signatures by 5/24.

Please reply with: APPROVE 35% | APPROVE 30% | DENY | NEED CFO SIGNOFF. If APPROVE, I’ll prepare the SOW/DocuSign and pricing exhibits.

Thanks — Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pricing sanction for Springwell (deal >20% discount)

Jordan —

Thanks for the concise ask and the attached MAP. I reviewed the numbers with finance. I am prepared to SANCTION up to 30% off list for this ARR profile and strategic value, with these hard conditions:
1) 12‑month committed volume and a tiered overage that kicks in at 30M tokens/mo (overage priced at list less 15%).
2) No less than 30‑day payment; if Springwell insists on 45 days we require a 2% finance surcharge to offset DSO risk or a revenue reserve holdback.
3) Include a 3% annualized price protection clause in the SOW if model economics materially change (protects us for model drift).
4) Legal to review the payment term change and include a limited revenue reserve escrow clause.

If Jordan can get a confirmation that Springwell will accept those conditions, proceed — Marissa approves the 30% concession. Anything above 30% requires CFO signoff (Karthik), who is looped here.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Global Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
